placeholders_used.question: Q12
placeholders_used.basis: Slow drift: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck with 2-sigma = this fraction of the accuracy, hard-clipped at it. Assumed split; real long-term stability is a datasheet/calibration-interval number.

placeholders_used.name: sensor_noise_sigma_frac
placeholders_used.question: Q12
placeholders_used.basis: Random per-sample noise sigma as a fraction of the accuracy (2-sigma = 0.2 x accuracy). Chosen so bias + drift + 2-sigma noise = 0.5 + 0.3 + 0.2 = 1.0 x accuracy, i.e. total error stays inside the stated spec.

placeholders_used.name: sensor_h2_zero_bias_frac
placeholders_used.question: Q12
placeholders_used.basis: Hydrogen channel only: the detector reads ~0 in healthy service and is assumed zero-referenced (clean-air zero check at commissioning), so most of the +/-2% FS is span error that is near zero at zero reading. Zero-offset bias bound = 0.1 x 2 %vol = 0.2 %vol. With the generic 0.5 the bound is 1.0 %vol and ~22% of simulated units would sit in a persistent 25%-LFL alarm.

placeholders_used.name: sensor_h2_zero_drift_frac
placeholders_used.question: Q12
placeholders_used.basis: Hydrogen channel only: zero drift bound 0.1 x accuracy (0.2 %vol); the generic 0.3 (0.6 %vol) alone would exceed a 10%-LFL alarm.
